title: The Morning Bus
text:
Tom takes the bus to school. The bus leaves at eight o'clock. It is blue and big. Tom sits next to his friend Ben.

Today the bus is late. Tom waits at the bus stop for ten minutes. Then the bus comes. Tom is not angry because he has time.

questions.text: What time does the bus leave?
How long does Tom wait at the bus stop?
How does Tom probably feel when the bus is late?
What kind of day does Tom probably have?

vocabulary.definition: a place where a bus stops for passengers
a person you know well and like

paragraph_translations: Tomek jeździ autobusem do szkoły. Autobus odjeżdża o ósmej. Jest niebieski i duży. Tomek siedzi obok swojego przyjaciela Bena.
Dzisiaj autobus się spóźnia. Tomek czeka na przystanku autobusowym przez dziesięć minut. Potem autobus przyjeżdża. Tomek nie jest zły, bo ma czas.
